Did you know about our 5 senses of our human body?
We have five magical senses — sight, hearing, smell, taste, and touch. Our eyes help us see, ears let us hear, nose smells, tongue tastes, and skin helps us feel things around us. These senses help us explore and enjoy the world every day!
